questions.answer: Matplotlib's original author was John D.
questions.explanation: Matplotlib's original author was John D. Hunter. He created it to make 2D scientific plots in Python, export publication-quality figures, and embed plots in interactive applications. Simple charts take only a few commands, while the object-oriented API allows detailed control.
